# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release and the latest LTS release are supported for security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you believe you have found a security issue, report it privately instead of opening a public issue.

Include as much detail as possible:

- A description of the issue
- The affected version
- Steps to reproduce or verify the problem
- Any suggested mitigation, if available

## Response process

Security reports should be reviewed promptly, and fixes will be prioritized for the latest release and the latest LTS release.
